item.title: At least 20 killed in school fire in rebel-held DR Congo city
item.description: Victims from the fire in AFC/M23-held Bukavu include primary school students, say officials and media reports.

item.title: Houthis capture Yemeni town of Mocha: Why it matters
item.description: The Houthi seizure of Mocha threatens global trade routes, severs vital supply lines, and displaces thousands in Yemen.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis seize strategic Red Sea city of Mocha
item.description: Houthis deliver 'significant blow' to the Yemeni government, expand control over Bab al-Mandeb, analysts say.

item.title: Houthis advance along Yemen’s southern Red Sea coast
item.description: Yemen’s Houthi rebels are advancing along the Red Sea coast, to gain more leverage over the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

item.title: Is Egypt’s Hamza Abdelkarim set to be Barcelona’s next breakout star?
item.description: Four goals in five games made the 18-year-old striker Barcelona's top scorer during preseason.

item.title: The Houthis are testing the limits of Saudi restraint
item.description: Riyadh needs to restore deterrence without being pulled back into a prolonged Yemen war.

item.title: IAEA accuses Iran of ‘noncompliance’
item.description: Nuclear watchdog has gone more than a year without inspecting key sites; Iran says US attacks have made access unsafe.

item.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
item.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

item.title: Muted US response to UK's West Bank sanctions may reflect simmering frustration
item.description: The UK accuses Israel's government of turning a blind eye to the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians by settlers.

item.title: Watch: How a community living under demolition orders from Israel view UK sanctions
item.description: Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson visits the Palestinian community of Khan al Ahmar, and the neighbouring Israeli settlement of Maale Admumim.
